text:
tom_sales: Heads-up: FinEdge asked for a 10-day POC to validate our Go/JS SDK streaming + function-call flow and stable structured JSON outputs. They also require SAML SSO, SCIM for service accounts, and a short reserved burst for onboarding. Can we kick off tomorrow morning?

ana_presales: Tomorrow 9am PT works for me. Quick questions from their infra lead:
ana_presales: 1) Can we stream tokens and emit function_call start/end events for progressive UI?
ana_presales: 2) Can we pin and enforce JSON schemas per route for parser validation?
ana_presales: 3) Are there blockers for SAML/SCIM/KMS on Dedicated vs Private?

jorge_engineer: Short answers: 1) Yes — SDKs emit token chunks and explicit function_call events. Example SSE frames:

jorge_engineer: ```
data: {"type":"token","text":"Hi"}

data: {"type":"function_call","name":"lookup","status":"start","id":"f1"}

data: {"type":"function_call","name":"lookup","status":"end","id":"f1","result":{"matches":2}}
```

jorge_engineer: 2) Yes — routes support a `strict_schema` flag that rejects nonconforming outputs and surfaces schema errors in the response stream.

mei_security: Private supports SAML+SCIM and customer-managed KMS. Dedicated supports SAML; SCIM for service accounts may need a small connector run in their VPC (2-4 days). Audit logs can be forwarded to their SIEM.

infra-bot: [infra] Temporary dedicated pool request queued by ana_presales: temp-pool-762. ETA ~3h after approval.

ana_presales: Proposed POC plan: Day0: provision pool + scoped tokens. Day1: SDK quickstart + schema/fixtures. Day2-4: streaming + function-call e2e and parser tests. Day5-9: reserved-burst scale tests and metrics. Handover with SSO/SCIM/KMS runbook.

tom_sales: Action list: ana confirm pricing, jorge provide minimal SSE + client backpressure note, mei review their security form. I'll send calendar invite once pricing is tentative.

jorge_engineer: Client backpressure note: use pause/resume when client buffer > threshold, keepalive 30s, reconnect with jitter.

mei_security: Question: are function_call payloads redacted in hosted logs by default?

jorge_engineer: By default we redact sensitive fields in hosted logs. For Private we can allow full payloads under customer KMS and controls.

ana_presales: Locking 9am PT tomorrow for kickoff. I'll post provisional pricing here EOD.
